observation: Independent agent PRs can become stale or duplicate when multiple workers initialize the same coordination cycle from different branch snapshots.
evidence: PRs #27 and #28 targeted stale main, PR #29 replayed a broad stale snapshot, and PR #30 duplicated Sentry state on master.
lesson: Use the repository default integration branch as the single lineage, serialize mutating stages, and hold on stale or conflicting handoffs.

observation: CI drift is a repository correctness issue when workflows invoke commands or artifacts that no longer exist.
evidence: The original workflow referenced check:links, check:spelling, build:cli, build:daemon, and bin/miad while package.json exposed different commands.
lesson: Every CI job must map to a currently supported repository command and artifact; verify this contract during maintenance reviews.

observation: Generated documentation jobs can be misleading when a generator has no true dry-run mode.
evidence: gen:skill-docs always writes output, so the historical --dry-run CI invocation did not represent a real supported interface.
lesson: Do not simulate dry-run semantics through unsupported CLI flags; either implement a real dry-run contract or keep generation outside deterministic verification gates.
